title: Task and Flow Execution
summary: This module orchestrates the execution of tasks and complex flows, managing conditional logic, human feedback, persistence, and visualization of workflows.

nodes.label: Conditional Task
nodes.title: Conditional Task
nodes.description: Defines a task that executes based on a condition evaluated against previous task output, enabling dynamic workflow branching.

nodes.label: Hallucination Guardrail
nodes.title: Hallucination Guardrail
nodes.description: A placeholder for a feature that would validate task outputs against hallucination criteria using an LLM, ensuring factual consistency.

nodes.label: Flow Runtime
nodes.title: Flow Runtime
nodes.description: The core engine for executing flows, managing state, method calls, event handling, and persistence for complex workflows.

nodes.label: Flow DSL
nodes.title: Flow DSL
nodes.description: Provides decorators and utilities for defining flow methods, conditions, human feedback points, and routing logic within a flow.

nodes.label: Flow Persistence
nodes.title: Flow Persistence
nodes.description: Abstract base class and decorators for persisting flow state, enabling checkpointing, resuming, and handling human feedback across sessions.

nodes.label: Flow Visualization
nodes.title: Flow Visualization
nodes.description: Generates interactive HTML visualizations of flow structures, aiding in understanding and debugging complex workflows.

nodes.label: LLM Integration
nodes.title: LLM Integration
nodes.description: Manages interactions with various Large Language Models, providing a unified interface for different LLM providers.

nodes.label: Memory Management
nodes.title: Memory Management
nodes.description: Handles the storage, retrieval, and analysis of conversational and operational memories for agents and flows.

nodes.label: Event System
nodes.title: Event System
nodes.description: Manages the emission, listening, and processing of various events within the CrewAI framework, enabling reactive and observable behaviors.

nodes.label: General Utilities
nodes.title: General Utilities
nodes.description: Provides common utility functions and helper classes used across the CrewAI framework for various purposes like serialization, streaming, and logging.

groups.label: Flow Orchestration
groups.title: Flow Orchestration
groups.description: Components responsible for defining, executing, and managing the lifecycle of complex AI agent flows.

groups.label: Task Management
groups.title: Task Management
groups.description: Handles the definition and execution of individual tasks, including conditional logic and quality control.

groups.label: Data Management
groups.title: Data Management
groups.description: Manages the persistence of flow states and the integration with external memory systems.

groups.label: Observability and Tools
groups.title: Observability and Tools
groups.description: Provides tools for visualizing flow execution and integrating with external systems for logging and general utilities.
